AI Overview
67 Clicker
Video game
67 Clicker is a viral idle-clicker and meme-inspired game built around the internet "67" meme that went viral on TikTok and social media. 
Core Gameplay & Versions
Browser/Web Idle Game: The minimal HTML5 version features a glowing "67" in the middle of the screen. Players tap or click to earn "67" points, unlock active clicking multipliers, and buy passive upgrades or clicks-per-second (CPS) generators. You can check out the browser version directly at 67 Clicker. 
Roblox Simulator Versions: There are also Roblox adaptations (such as clicker simulators) where players click to display meme faces, equip floating picture pets (like custom meme blocks), unlock different worlds, use auto-clickers, and perform rebirths for higher multipliers.
